fields.Name: W1 -> S7.1
fields.Description: Gate G3.1 (owner PR 4, phase 3, dataset W1, criterion S7.1): train on W1-signal s42, remove the artifact directory, restart and score: the model is shown unscorable and the run fails loudly, 1 of 1; with the artifact kept, a restart scores 16,776 of 16,776 (T11; 5 Published models and the L4 Draft lost artifacts after a reboot today). The check scores the lost model once before removing its stored object (so MJAPI's loader and the sidecar's warm cache are warm) and requires ARTIFACT_MISSING and ArtifactStatus 'missing' after; it scores a kept model, restarts the truth sidecar (HarnessSidecar.Restart) and requires 16,776 of 16,776 scored on both sides with bit-identical predictions and an unchanged registered SHA-256 (D4-59). A check cannot restart the MJAPI its client provider talks to, so the MJAPI half of the restart is M2's runtime exit step.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The lost-artifact model is refused ARTIFACT_MISSING and shown 'missing', 1 of 1; the kept model scores 16,776 of 16,776 before and after a sidecar restart with bit-identical predictions.
